title: Documents folder
whyItMatters: The Documents folder holds personal and work files that a new owner could read straight from the disk.
source: Apple Support, add Desktop and Documents to iCloud Drive: https://support.apple.com/en-us/109344
notes: Documents is TCC-protected; a live scan needs Full Disk Access. iCloud-synced items may be placeholders, counted by metadata and never hydrated.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy anything you want to keep to an external drive or another computer before touching this folder.
steps: Open the folder named in the plan and decide file by file what has to go.
Move the files you keep to an external drive, then check that they open.
Move the rest to the Trash, then empty the Trash before the handover.
cleanup.risk: Everything left in Documents is deleted for good once the Trash is emptied; only copies made elsewhere survive.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Add Desktop and Documents to iCloud Drive: https://support.apple.com/en-us/109344
